source.summary_oneline: Replace ArangoDB (licence change) with a coherent ontology-graph backend: PostgreSQL for the ontology + SurrealDB for the knowledge store

plan.note: Plan shown to the user in the session and executed without waiting for an explicit y/edit/abort; the review gate (Phase 4) is the first blocking gate.

research.note: All 30 planned queries ran, plus one parent follow-up (Q017 → F017). The advisory per-lane wall limit (255 s) was exceeded by two lanes and was not enforced: no lane was failed or re-run. 30+ cross-lane follow-ups recorded in finding Notes were not executed (budget); the material ones are listed in synthesis.meta.notes. After the first commit the user pointed to the research note `sdd/proposals/Grafos open source para ai-parrot.md`; it was read in full and recorded as F032 (Q032).

codebase.note: plus FC-017, a sequential parent follow-up after the lanes (4 greps, 1 git call)

merge.note: Merged pairs: FC-001+FW-001, FC-009+FW-002, FC-010+FW-003. Eight further citations duplicated across topically distinct findings were removed from the later finding with a pointer note instead of merging the findings.

citation_probe.note: Run inline by a script instead of sdd-contract-probe agents: all 145 cited repository paths exist and every cited line range is inside its file. Six citations name the enclosing symbol while citing lines inside its body; one symbol label is a file label. No finding needed a [citation-check] tag.

synthesis.note: Re-derived after the review gate: the user's four answers adopt the draft in full, so the enrichment block was rewritten and U5 added; lint re-run and passed. Second revision: F032 added, C14/C15 raised to medium, C21–C23 added; lint passed.

review.note: Review gate and Q&A were presented together: the summary in the session, then U1–U4 as one question dialog.

qa.note: U1–U4 answered by the user; U5 (destination of the instance-graph pipeline) arises from the answers to U2 and U3 and is deferred to the spec.

output.next_command_rationale: the user closed the four architectural forks in favour of the draft and localization is high-confidence; the spec must phase the programme, start with spike G1 and settle U5
